steps.text: A circuit is a complete loop for current to flow. Let's build one that lights a bulb.
Place the components — connect the cell, the bulb, and the switch with wires into a loop.
Now tap “Test” with the switch closed. If the loop is complete, current flows and the bulb glows.
The bulb lights only when the circuit is closed (a complete loop). Any gap — a break or an open switch — stops the current and the bulb goes dark.

coach.mission: Build a closed circuit that lights the bulb.
whenStuck: Connect the cell, bulb, and switch into one complete loop.
Close the switch, then test the circuit.
whenWrong: The bulb lights only in a complete, closed loop.
A gap or an open switch breaks the circuit and the bulb stays off.
whenCorrect: Right — a complete closed loop lit the bulb.
Good — current needs an unbroken path.
coach.done: You've built a working circuit. Explore more, or move on when you're ready.
